evidence.excerpt: 报告期内，公司自主品牌 SAFETRON 系列支持设备业务量已接近系统集成业务总量的 40%，各类高纯特气设备和高纯化学品设备累计出货超过 5.4 万台，有效改变了此前由境外厂商垄断的市场格局。

notes: SAFETRON-branded high-purity specialty-gas and high-purity chemical supply equipment, i.e. fab gas/chemical delivery hardware that connects to process chambers. These units are NOT wafer process tools and the count must not be read as process-tool shipments; the 台 unit here is a supply-equipment unit, not a fab process system. Conversion is exact: 5.4 万台 x 10,000 = 54,000 台. 超过 preserved as relation gt — a lower bound, never a point value. Same figure restated at physical pp.15 and 17 of this filing: p.15 states the accumulation basis as 2017 年至今 (from 2017 onward), so the cumulative window opens in 2017 rather than at company inception; p.17 attributes the same 5.4万台 to 公司自主品牌 SAFETRON 系列支持设备, while the p.13 and p.15 count clauses name only 各类高纯特气设备和高纯化学品设备 — the broader SAFETRON basket (precursor, slurry, abatement, dry-tool gas modules) is the p.17 framing, not the count clause's own wording. Successor to zhichun_annual_2025 p.24 (>4.9万台 at 2025-12-31, observation ZHICHUN-2025-12-31-HIGH-PURITY-SUPPORT-CUMULATIVE-SHIPMENTS). That FY2025 row is already registered with category_id=fab_gas_chemical_delivery and precision=reported_lower_bound, i.e. already aligned with this row; the two form one comparable series as they stand and no realignment is required.
